title: Mean under coordinate averaging
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and choose any coordinate $i$. Replace the value of $f$ at each input by the average of its values when coordinate $i$ is set to $+1$ and to $-1$. This coordinate average has the same mean as $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
